description: This file defines a partial class for the AdminLeaderboard web page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It includes event handlers for page load, navigation buttons, and search functionality, with most database operations commented out. The class manages user interactions and page navigation within the online examination system.

classes.name: AdminLeaderboard
classes.description: A partial class representing the AdminLeaderboard web page, handling page events and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial load of the page, currently with commented-out database data loading logic.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the Leaderboard button, currently empty.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Handles the search button event, with database search code commented out and sets a session variable.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the login page.
